template.colour: RGB hex from tokens.json (official tokens); print values (CMYK) are in tokens.json

cut_contour.note: Proposal: the source has no cut contour. Corner radius 4.2 mm is borrowed from the diefstal footer bar (4.23 mm); to be confirmed by the owner.

reference_note: Faithful vector reproduction of the source page (source colours as a viewer shows them, original copy including typos). Hidden leftovers are listed under omitted.
omitted: Hidden full-page grey underlay (CMYK 25/18/20/2, viewer #BDBFBF, 256 x 306 mm) under the blue background; not PY-Grijs, a leftover.
notes: Layout measured on LaadKabel.pdf: navy background into the 3 mm bleed, plug icon (light aqua, kept as sampled #68CBDB, no token), NL/EN text Ubuntu 21.47 mm white leading 1.2 centred, white divider 0.706 mm x 170.6 mm, library logo py-atom-logo-horizontal-white scaled by height (beeldmerk 11.1 mm, logo about 40 mm wide) centred at the bottom. The source blue is CMYK 100/85.9/6.6/0 (drift); the template uses the token blue. Variables: NL text lines and EN text lines as live text (the bold phrases are runs). The cut contour is a proposal: no contour in the source, radius 4.2 mm taken from the diefstal footer.
